ms.text:
MP1
Correct circuit diagram to include test wire, power source, ammeter and voltmeter
MP2
Correct symbols used for ammeter and voltmeter.
MP3
At least 3 different metals (or alloys) suggested
MP4
Measure potential difference and current. Work out resistance
MP5
Repeat with at least two more wires of different material.
MP6
Key variables:
Any one from:
Length of wire
Diameter / thickness / cross-sectional area of wire
MP7
Table with columns for material, potential difference, current and resistance with units V, A, Ω.
